page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr8i.32xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 128 dedicated vCPUs utilizing Intel Xeon 6462C processors operating at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz. The instance is equipped with 1024.0 GB of system memory, establishing an 8.0 GB memory-to-vCPU ratio.

This server configuration does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage options. For high-throughput data transfers, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 100 Gbps. There are no complimentary public IPv4 addresses included with this instance.

Given the memory-to-core ratio of 1:8, this instance is classified as memory-optimized. The combination of 128 dedicated Intel Xeon vCPUs and 1024.0 GB of RAM makes it suitable for memory-intensive enterprise workloads, large-scale databases, in-memory caching systems, and heavy data processing pipelines. The lack of local storage requires careful architectural planning for disk-heavy applications, relying entirely on network-attached storage over the 100 Gbps network interface.
